parsed.note_claim: The Apollo 11 spacecraft filmed the first step with a pre-positioned camera in the lunar module, and transmitted low-resolution slow-scan TV at 10 fps.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Positioning the camera in the MESA made it possible to telecast the astronauts' first steps as they climbed down the LM's ladder at the start of a mission's first moonwalk/EVA.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the camera was pre-positioned in the MESA to film the first steps and specifies the 10 fps slow-scan transmission rate.
